candidates.source_description:
Willie Smits is a Dutch-born conservationist who has spent decades working with orangutans in Indonesian Borneo. His relationship with the species began in 1989, when he found a severely ill baby orangutan in a market and nursed her back to health. That experience eventually led to the creation of what became the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation.
